directBroker.title: Direct broker connections
directBroker.help: Connect your broker API to an investment account. Credentials stay in the protected store on this device or private server.
directBroker.selectMember: Select a family member to manage their broker connections.
directBroker.iciciHelp: ICICI Breeze: demat holdings preview, identified by ISIN. Broker stock codes are not NSE tickers. Breeze market coverage is NSE only.
directBroker.kiteHelp: Zerodha Kite: equity holdings preview. Unsettled trades, mutual funds and full transaction history are not included in this preview.
directBroker.configured: Credentials saved. Fetch holdings to check the current session.
directBroker.steps: Register your own API app with the broker and set its redirect URL. Enter your API key, open the official login, then copy only the request_token (Zerodha) or API_Session (ICICI) from the redirected URL. Broker passwords and OTPs belong only on the broker website. API availability and charges are controlled by your broker.
directBroker.previewHelp: Read-only preview. Nothing has been added to your portfolio. Current quantities do not provide purchase dates or transaction history; use a tradebook import for accurate returns and cost basis.
